title: Electrophysiological markers of surprise-induced failures of visual and auditory awareness
description: EEG recordings from 33 participants who each completed both a visual and an auditory surprise task, with task order counterbalanced. The dataset supports investigation of electrophysiological markers of surprise-induced failures of visual and auditory awareness. Data from participants excluded at various analysis stages are included up to the stage of processing they reached.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an OpenBCI system during counterbalanced visual and auditory surprise tasks. Because of incorrect settings in OpenBCI GUI v5.0.1, recorded values are 24 times larger than actual, so the units are microvolts / 24, as specified in the channels.tsv files.
